title: Linear Programme 1
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a phenomenon where the algorithm terminates because it was unable to find a departing variable. 7."
Unboundedness is a phenomenon where the algorithm terminates because it was unable to find a departing variable. 7.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the entry in the first row and second column."
Note that the pivot is the entry in the first row and second column.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a phenomenon of obtaining a degenerate basic feasible solution in an LPP."
Degeneracy is a phenomenon of obtaining a degenerate basic feasible solution in an LPP.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the one having the maximum ratio."
The entering variable is the one having the maximum ratio.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used to solve problems which start dual feasible (i.e., whose primal is optimal but infeasible)."
The dual simplex method is used to solve problems which start dual feasible (i.e., whose primal is optimal but infeasible).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the entry in the third row and the first column."
The pivot is the entry in the third row and the first column.
fib: ______ is the optimal basis before the constraint am+1x ≤ bm+1 is added.

______ is a feasible solution (not necessary basic), which minimizes the total cost.
Optimal solution is a feasible solution (not necessary basic), which minimizes the total cost.

Simplex method is the most important tool that had been developed to solve linear programming problems.
______ is a mathematical technique which in- volves the allocation of limited resources in an optimal manner, on the basis of a given criterion of optimality.
Linear programming is a mathematical technique which in- volves the allocation of limited resources in an optimal manner, on the basis of a given criterion of optimality.

Otherwise the dual simplex method is used to find the new optimal solution by restoring feasibility.
